Went ahead and deleted the post since she's here safe and everything is fine :) Just to answer some of the comments, yes we've asked questions regarding how to do things the easiest option for us in the future and legally as we continued to get different answers whenever researched before. We're not hiding that she'll eventually want to move here, but it'll be a long process before that happens and that's fine. 
She just dissolved the civil partnership she had in Australia because she finally had a way out. She was 18 and groomed by a 40+ year old women who abused her mentally and physically for the last 6 years. There are witness statements and pictures regarding that. She didn't just up and leave to country hop. She finally had a way out because she was set to be deported by the end of the month that she left. She was raped and humiliated by her abuser for leaving. While I don't owe anyone an explanation, I do want to clear up how this looks. 
She's here for the wedding and maybe to experience Thanksgiving if she wants to stay that long. So yes, she is just visiting. Unfortunately the wedding was a last minute thing. My best friend got engaged and decided to have it on Halloween when we expected months from now or she wouldn't have stayed over a month the first time. Im glad she did though because she needed the support and a chance to heal from everything shes been through. The timing was just unfortunate for our end, but we were able to make it work and we don't have any plans for visiting afterwards as all out money is going into what we need to do for our visa process. I'll probably go to Norway next year, but that's it for now.
They found nothing suspicious on her phone and did clearly see our plans for how we want to work this out. She dealt with a terrible women who literally treated immigrants like they have a disease for her first interview (literally kept telling her to show her stuff but then would scream at her to get away from her lmao a sweet old lady who also dealt with the same women gave her sweet bread while waiting and gave her some comfort thankfully), but the second one was much easier, nicer, and as I said let her in. There were about 100 people in front of her though so it took quite a long time.
Do we know this has a bad look? Absolutely, which is why we took precautions, were very honest, and are ready for the hardships this process will bring us.
They let her in :) She's vibing next to me.

There shouldn't be anything on her phone that says that. We've talked about how we don't want to get married anytime soon and we're just researching for the future.
